terms.comment: Our description: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for a development cycle. Cursus, cursūs m., a course; ēlabōrātiō, ēlabōrātiōnis f., persevering labour, a working out (Auct. Her. 4.32, in Lewis & Short). Morgan–Owens’s word for development in general is ēvolūtiō.

sources: Lewis & Short: cursus · Lewis & Short: elaboratio
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. development.
